LightningComponentBundle.description: Monitoring console: severity KPI strip, severity mix, and a filterable hot-tier entry stream.

property.name: headline
property.label: Console title
property.description: Heading shown at the top of the console.

property.name: defaultWindowDays
property.label: Default summary window (days)
property.description: Trailing window used by the KPI strip and severity mix.

property.name: defaultRowLimit
property.label: Entries to load
property.description: How many of the newest hot-tier entries are fetched (server cap is 200).

property.name: pageSize
property.label: Rows per page
property.description: Rows rendered per page in the entry stream.
